verdict.rationale: Production monitoring and alerting is a fair axis for a voice-agent framework that has cloud deployment. However, the evidence pack documents only pre-production testing (behavioral tests, simulations), cloud deployment and rollback. It shows no live-call monitoring dashboards and no alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes. A community report also describes running LiveKit agents with no way to measure latency or debug calls, which is consistent with this absence.
